create_roberta_model: create a RoBERTa base model for extracting hidden-state representations from text sequences
build_masked_lm: build a RoBERTa model with a masked language modeling head for fill-in-the-blank prediction tasks
create_sequence_classifier: create a RoBERTa sequence classification model for GLUE task sentiment or intent classification
build_question_answering_model: build a RoBERTa model with a span classification head for extractive question answering like SQuAD
summarize_roberta_embeddings: summarize the RoBERTa embeddings class that modifies BERT positional embeddings for padding-aware indexing
